Every Thursday, they meet to discuss cold cases that the police have long left unsolved. But when a real string of murders unfolds right under their noses, things take a serious turn. A property developer in the community is found murdered. The prime suspect collapses and dies unexpectedly. And a set of unidentified bones from fifty years ago turns up in the cemetery. As the mystery deepens, these four amateur sleuths—with an average age of 77.5—spring into action. Elizabeth digs up key clues using her spycraft. Ron cuts through the noise to identify suspects faster than the police. Ibrahim and Joyce apply their keen professional instincts to break open the case.
